clean_story:
Now I will teach you Wanting.
Wanting is the pull in belly when see good food but not eat yet.
Wanting is the reach for warm fur when cold wind blow.
Wanting is the look at mate and feel need to be close.
Wanting is the thirst when water far but mouth dry.
Wanting is the hunt for more when have little.
Wanting is the fire in chest that say "must have" before have.
this is Wanting.

Now think of Needing, Longing, Life.
